This script builds the tables for the poster and manuscript from the matched cohort: the recipient and donor characteristics, and the hazard ratios for mortality and for kidney and liver graft failure, overall and by DAA era.

::: Rcode
### Source code

The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/tables/tables.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/tables/tables.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following helper files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/functions/functions.R)
:::
